kind.instructions: state.path is a URL path that returned HTTP 404 on state.site, with state.hits requests in the access log. state.site_profile describes the real content of the site. Classify what kind of request this is. A path counts as content_url only if its words fit the site profile; generic paths that scanners try on every site are probes.

criteria.content_url: An old page, post, category, service, course or event URL whose words match the site profile, which real visitors or search engines may still want.
criteria.broken_link: A real page path with an extra segment that looks like a broken relative link, such as a phone number, email or a repeated path appended to it.
criteria.missing_asset: A missing image, stylesheet, script, font, video or document file.
criteria.attack_probe: A vulnerability scan or a generic path tried on many sites: admin panels, config files, backups, shells, directory listings, or generic names like old, shop, demo, about, impressum, years.
criteria.junk: A malformed URL, spam query or tracking artifact with no real content behind it.
